newsitem.title: UK: Aerodata in bid talks with Scott Pickford.
newsitem.headline: Aerodata in bid talks with Scott Pickford.

text.p: Australia's Aerodata Holdings Ltd said on Thursday that it is talks with British geo-science and engineering group Scott Pickford Plc in relation to a possible offer for the firm at 53p per share.
Aerodata said it had noted the announcement made earlier today by U.S.-based Core Laboratories NV regarding its 53p per share cash offer for Scott Pickford.
Core Laboratories' offer values Scott Pickford's share capital at about 6.7 million stg.
Core Laboratories, which provides petroleum reservoir rock and fluids analyses, said that Scott Pickford's board has indicated it would recommend the offer.
Aerodata has a 21.5 percent stake in Scott Pickford.
